definitions.gloss: wasted effort; fruitless labor; vain attempt
definitions.explanation: Effort or trouble that produces no result. Emphasizes the futility of the work expended.

examples.japanese: {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧。
⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧、{無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: In the end, it turned out to be a wasted effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無駄骨|むだぼね}だった。
examples.english: I went out of my way to go, but it was all for nothing.

examples.japanese: {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}らない→折る：01263_oru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should check in advance so you don't waste your efforts.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧ (futile, useless) + ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ (bone; effort, trouble). The ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ here refers to effort or labor (as in ⟦{骨|ほね}を{折|お}る→骨を折る：17002_honewooru⟧, "to make an effort"), so {無駄骨|むだぼね} literally means "useless effort."

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the expression {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧ (to waste one's efforts) or {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end up being a wasted effort). Often used when someone went to considerable trouble only to achieve nothing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧ — to waste one's efforts
- {無駄骨|むだぼね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる — to end in wasted effort
- {無駄骨|むだぼね}だった — it was a wasted effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徒労|とろう}→徒労：15513_torou⟧ — futile effort (more literary/formal)
- ⟦{骨折|ほねお}り{損|ぞん}→骨折り損：08029_honeorizon⟧ — effort that went unrewarded (emphasizes the loss)
- ⟦{無駄足|むだあし}→無駄足：17395_mudaashi⟧ — wasted trip (specifically about going somewhere for nothing)
